title: My first attempt at making a game - a casual pirate tactics game where you battle for control of a small cluster of islands.
author: Zealousideal_Two833
selftext:
https://yarrgame.itch.io/yarr

I wanted to make a pirate themed, casual, and mobile friendly game inspired by Carrier Command from the 90s. 

You control a ship and must capture islands - they generate resources for you, so you can buy upgrades for your ship and your island forts. At the same time, other captains are also trying to capture territory, and as well as battling eachother you all have to look out for random events which can ruin your strategy. 

There are 13 different rival captains, each with their own play style, so different combinations of opponents should ensure that each game feels different. 

Graphics are deliberately low-poly, because I want it to be playable on any potato PC or cheap phone. 

Would appreciate any feedback.

comments.author: SummonerRPG
comments.body: Nice job on publishing something. One suggestion is that you could make the UI less busy. There's so much text and instructions all over the place it's overwhelming

replies.author: Zealousideal_Two833
replies.body: Thanks - I think I was worried that players might not get what was going on in the game, so I wanted to make sure they got useful information - but I can see that it's probably too much.
